headline_item.title_zh: 中国AI产业规模化落地知识蒸馏技术
headline_item.title_en: A review of 300+ Chinese documents shows AI distillation has moved from academic experiments to widespread industrial use, with Beijing encouraging the practice (Reuters)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 中国科研及产业机构通过知识蒸馏技术，实现将高性能大模型能力向轻量化模型的高效迁移
headline_item.event_summary_en: Over 300 Chinese technical documents indicate that AI knowledge distillation has transitioned from academic research to large-scale industrial deployment. Organizations are transferring sophisticated logic from frontier models to lightweight student models, significantly reducing computational overhead and operational costs under strategic policy encouragement.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】中国科研机构、AI技术企业在中国境内产业技术研发环境：将高算力模型能力蒸馏至轻量化模型以实现产业规模化应用
【起因与机理】降低大模型算力部署门槛并提升业务端性能表现
【关键技术规格】核心技术路径：将教师模型复杂能力迁移至轻量级学生模型。
【各方立场与态度】战略动因：降低算力资源依赖与运营部署成本。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Chinese research institutes and AI tech enterprises (Domestic industrial R&D ecosystem): Scalable industrial deployment of knowledge distillation
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To lower computational thresholds and optimize deployment efficiency
[Key Technical Spec] Core technique: Knowledge distillation for model capability transfer.
[Key Position & Outlook] Strategic driver: Mitigating computational bottlenecks and operational overhead.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此举标志着中国AI产业正从盲目堆叠参数的‘军备竞赛’转向基于工程化效率的‘降本增效’路线。通过知识蒸馏在终端侧实现模型能力嫁接，将有效规避高端算力受限风险，并构建起区别于硅谷大参数规模化的分布式边缘智能生态。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This indicates a strategic shift in the Chinese AI industry from a parameter-heavy 'arms race' to an efficiency-driven deployment model. By leveraging distillation for edge-side model capability grafting, firms can mitigate high-end compute constraints while establishing a distributed edge-intelligence ecosystem distinct from Silicon Valley's massive-scale models.

headlines.title_en: Nvidia unveils its Rubin HPC GPU with "more than 50,000" CUDA cores, up from 28,672 in the current Rubin GPU, for agentic workflows and scientific simulations (Jeffrey Kampman/Tom's Hardware)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 英伟达推出Rubin HPC GPU，集成超5万个CUDA核心，旨在通过NVLink 7互联强化科研与智能体工作流，预计2028年上市
headlines.event_summary_en: Nvidia unveiled its Rubin HPC GPU designed for scientific simulation and agentic workflows, featuring over 50,000 CUDA cores and NVLink 7 interconnect technology. The architecture utilizes a multi-die configuration to scale compute density and minimize idle resources, with a market release scheduled for 2028.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达（Nvidia）在高性能计算产品规划发布：发布集成超5万CUDA核心的Rubin HPC GPU及NVLink 7互联技术
【起因与机理】满足科研领域对智能体工作流及海量数据模拟的算力爆发性需求
【关键数据与实测】核心架构：集成超5万个CUDA核心，支持多裸片封装与NVLink 7互联。
【涉及范围与推进】后续节点：产品计划于2028年正式推向市场。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Nvidia: Announced Rubin HPC GPU with 50,000+ CUDA cores and NVLink 7 interconnect
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To address growing computational demands in scientific simulations and agentic workflows
[Key Technical Spec] Architecture: 50,000+ CUDA cores with multi-die packaging and NVLink 7 support.
[Scope & Next Steps] Timeline: Market release scheduled for 2028.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 英伟达通过Rubin HPC进一步强化HPC领域护城河，利用多裸片封装技术平衡大语言模型推理与高性能科学计算的双重需求。其核心竞争力在于NVLink 7提供的超高吞吐带宽，旨在物理层面解决集群扩展限制，强迫市场在超大规模基础设施建设中持续依赖其私有生态。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Nvidia is deepening its competitive moat in HPC by leveraging multi-die packaging to balance LLM inference and scientific computing. The critical value lies in NVLink 7's high-throughput interconnect, which forces reliance on Nvidia's proprietary ecosystem for large-scale data center infrastructure.

headlines.title_zh: 美国商务部调查Megaspeed出口违规
headlines.title_en: The US Commerce Department says it began probing Megaspeed in 2024 over possible export rule violations; Nvidia put Megaspeed on its "no sell" list in June 2025 (Kanishka Singh/Reuters)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美国商务部与司法部联合证实，自2024年起对新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed展开调查，指控其涉嫌违规转运敏感半导体技术
headlines.event_summary_en: The US Commerce and Justice Departments confirmed a probe into Singapore-based Megaspeed since 2024 for potential unauthorized diversion of sensitive semiconductors. Following a June 2025 on-site inspection and executive interview, Nvidia formally blacklisted the firm, and the case has transitioned into a criminal investigation led by the Justice Department.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国商务部、美国司法部、Megaspeed国际（新加坡云服务商）、前Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang、前Megaspeed CEO Alice Huang在美国司法/监管调查体系及新加坡：针对敏感芯片潜在转运至受限地区的违规调查，以及针对Megaspeed的刑事立案
【起因与机理】防范高性能算力芯片绕过出口管制进入地缘政治博弈中的高风险渠道
【调查与监管诉求】监管机构指控Megaspeed存在敏感半导体产品违规转运风险。
【涉及范围与推进】案件已由贸易合规核查升级为刑事调查，并涉及对前核心高管的跨境盘查。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] US Department of Commerce, US Department of Justice, Megaspeed International, former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, former Megaspeed CEO Alice Huang: Investigation into unauthorized diversion of sensitive semiconductors and subsequent criminal probe
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Preventing circumvention of export controls for high-performance computing hardware
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Regulatory allegations of unauthorized semiconductor diversion by Megaspeed.
[Scope & Next Steps] Case escalated from export control review to a formal criminal investigation involving high-level executive questioning.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 本案揭示了美国监管机构正将出口管制执行重心从纯粹的贸易限制转向针对海外云数据中心节点的物理现场核查与刑事打击。Nvidia与渠道伙伴关系的切断，反映出芯片巨头在面对监管压力时，已将“合规隔离”视为保护其全球供应链生态的核心底线，这将迫使东南亚地区的第三方云服务商面临更严格的终端用户审查机制。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This case signifies a shift in US enforcement toward on-site physical verification and criminal litigation for overseas cloud data centers. Nvidia’s preemptive blacklisting highlights the transition toward 'compliance isolation' as the new standard for global semiconductor supply chains, forcing regional cloud service providers to adopt stringent end-user vetting protocols.

titans.quote_zh:
RT @halcyonrayes：我要求 claude 在 cuda c++ 中完全实现 trellis.2，它比原始 pytorch 实现快 5.3 倍 🚀

令人惊讶的是，glb-export 函数是瓶颈，而不是神经网络本身。将导出转移到 GPU 带来的收益比其他任何东西都多。

- 零 Python 运行时，全部用 C++ 实现 ⚡️
- 费用💵？克劳德约 7 美元，计算约 60 美元，用于通过 @huggingface 作业在 h200 上进行测试
- 它仍然提供了 2.2 倍更好的性能，同时按位相同🎯

该代码是开源的，可以在这里使用——

将其用作代理优化模型的来源，或直接使用它。黑客快乐！ 🤗
titans.quote_en:
RT @halcyonrayes: i asked claude to implement trellis.2 fully in cuda c++, and it is 5.3x faster than the original pytorch implementation 🚀 

surprisingly, the glb-export function was the bottleneck, not the neural net itself. moving exporting to the gpu gave more gains than anything else.

- zero python runtime, all in c++ ⚡️
- cost 💵 ? ~$7 on claude and ~$60 on compute for testing on h200s through @huggingface jobs 
- it still gave 2.2x better perf while being bitwise identical 🎯

the code is open-sourced for use here -- https://t.co/YDxMFveRnC

use it as a source for your agent to optimize your models, or utilize it directly. happy hacking! 🤗
